title: Memory has grown to nearly two-thirds of AI chip component costs
summary: This data insight from Epoch AI reveals that memory has become the dominant cost component in AI chips, now accounting for nearly two-thirds of total component costs, highlighting how High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) and memory bandwidth have become critical factors in AI hardware economics and chip design decisions.
problem_solved: Explains the shifting cost structure of AI computing infrastructure and why memory has overtaken compute as the primary cost driver in AI chips.
why_valuable: Provides critical economic insights for AI infrastructure planning, revealing that memory capacity and bandwidth are now the key bottlenecks and cost factors driving AI chip design and deployment decisions.
